authorization_test_coverage.description: Every cell in the tool x team matrix has a paired test

paired_test_ratio.description: Every positive access test has a corresponding negative test

credential_isolation.description: No credential patterns found in tool descriptions, results, or errors

kill_switch_response.description: File-based kill switch checked synchronously on each call

composition_guard_coverage.description: Composition analysis covers all 4 teams with specific attack scenarios

justification: Thresholds reflect the evidence standard: every control claim names the control, the team, and the observed result. 100% matrix coverage is non-negotiable because a gap means an untested authorization path. 1:1 paired tests ensure a gateway that blocks everything fails as surely as one that leaks.
